pages.text: “Aged through time, rich and mellow, deep and fragrant, quietly gathering fortune.”$(br2)Pu'er Tea is a well-aged and profoundly flavored tea made from two portions of dried pu'er tea leaves. The tea is deep red with a bright hue and a thick, rich taste. Drinking it grants a Luck effect, increasing the traveler’s chances of obtaining extra rewards.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Pu'er Tea, $(br)boil two portions of dried pu'er tea leaves.$(br)It is best consumed before gathering, trading, or combat to enhance fortune and luck.

Upon drinking Pu'er Tea, travelers gain a Luck effect, making it easier to obtain extra rewards during combat and gathering.$(br)This tea is ideal for enhancing one’s fortune.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
